$meta.name: Travel app design tokens - sprint 6 additions
$meta.status: Draft for Raz. DELTA ONLY on top of 0.6.0: every key below is new; no existing value changes; no new colours. Merge into docs/design/tokens.json and apps/mobile/src/theme/tokens.ts in the same PR that first uses them (docs/design/sprint-06/README.md section 13). Keys starting with '$check.' are contrast documentation only and are not merged into tokens.ts.
limits.push.note: Counted per user per device (AsyncStorage push.explainer.${userId}); every showing counts, however it was closed. At most once per app session. Never shown again after a final OS denial (README 2.2).
timing.push.note: explainerDelay: after FlightScreen or ReturnPrompt has closed. launchDelay: after globe ready + trips loaded + no re-consent, only if untouched. openingToastAfter: 'Opening your flight…' toast when locating the flight is slow. openTimeout: whole flightId -> trip lookup, then treated as offline. unregisterTimeout: sign-out waits at most this long for unregister_push_token (README 2.3, 4.1, 4.5, 6.4).
motion.push.previewIn.note: Proposal (README 10). Reduce motion: shown at rest immediately.
push.android.accentColorNote: Same value as color.primitive.sky.600 / color.light.action.primary.bg. Not a new colour.
push.content.note: Hebrew title and body are prefixed in code with U+200F so Android lays the paragraph out RTL even when it starts with the flight number. English gets no prefix. Times are HH:mm h23 in the airport's own zone (dep_tz / arr_tz) with its IATA code; the date is appended when the new local date differs from the scheduled one (README 3).
size.notificationIcon.note: White (#FFFFFF), fully opaque, on transparent. Nose up so it needs no RTL mirroring in the status bar. Reused at 16 in the UI as PlaneUpIcon (README 3.5).
color.switch.map: No new colours. trackColor.false = border.control, trackColor.true = action.primary.bg; thumb on = action.primary.fg (light #FFFFFF, dark #060B18); thumb off = light #FFFFFF, dark text.primary #F3F6FC. React Native Switch, no custom control (README 6.1).
$check.contrast.method: WCAG 2.x relative luminance, (L1+0.05)/(L2+0.05), on the hex values in tokens.json. Text 4.5:1, graphics 3:1 (1.4.11).
$check.contrast.preview: All existing pairs: text.primary / text.secondary on bg.surface, text.secondary on bg.tag (6.77 / 7.01), text.link on bg.surface (6.06 / 8.37).
